name: Retained-oxide planar conception
summary: Hoerni's idea of leaving the protective oxide layer on a silicon chip and opening only small contact holes, which became the basis of flat, reliable chip-making.
description: Hoerni proposed leaving oxide over the junction edges while opening contact areas, instead of stripping the oxide after diffusion.
tier_reason: A bounded technical contribution, transmission episode or documented configuration useful within a specific history; no broad dependence claim is established.
why: Mesa transistors with exposed junctions were unreliable because their surfaces picked up contamination.
